title: Count Different Palindromic Subsequences
key_insight: 区间DP统计不同回文子序列数量，需处理重复计数
approach:
1. dp[i][j]表示s[i..j]中不同回文子序列数
2. 按区间长度递增计算
3. 对首尾字符相同时找内层边界
4. 根据内外层关系转移
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def countPalindromicSubsequences(self, s):
        MOD = 10**9+7
        n = len(s)
        dp = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
        for i in range(n): dp[i][i] = 1
        for l in range(2, n+1):
            for i in range(n-l+1):
                j = i+l-1
                if s[i] == s[j]:
                    lo, hi = i+1, j-1
                    while lo <= hi and s[lo] != s[i]: lo += 1
                    while hi >= lo and s[hi] != s[i]: hi -= 1
                    if lo > hi: dp[i][j] = dp[i+1][j-1]*2+2
                    elif lo == hi: dp[i][j] = dp[i+1][j-1]*2+1
                    else: dp[i][j] = dp[i+1][j-1]*2-dp[lo+1][hi-1]
                else: dp[i][j] = dp[i+1][j]+dp[i][j-1]-dp[i+1][j-1]
                dp[i][j] %= MOD
        return dp[0][n-1] % MOD

2. L在start中的位置>=在end中的位置(只能左移)
3. R在start中的位置<=在end中的位置(只能右移)
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def canTransform(self, start, end):
        if start.replace('X','') != end.replace('X',''): return False
        i = j = 0
        n = len(start)
        while i < n and j < n:
            while i < n and start[i] == 'X': i += 1
            while j < n and end[j] == 'X': j += 1
            if i == n or j == n: break
            if start[i] != end[j]: return False
            if start[i] == 'L' and i < j: return False
            if start[i] == 'R' and i > j: return False
            i += 1; j += 1
        return True

title: K-th Symbol in Grammar
key_insight: 第n行第k个字符由第n-1行第(k+1)/2个字符决定，奇数位相同偶数位取反
approach:
1. 递归：第n行第k个=第n-1行第(k+1)//2个
2. 若k为奇数则与父节点相同
3. 若k为偶数则与父节点相反
4. 基础情况：第1行第1个为0

title: Reaching Points
key_insight: 从目标逆推回起点：(x,y)只能由(x-y,y)或(x,y-x)得来，用取模加速
approach:
1. 从(tx,ty)逆推回(sx,sy)
2. 若tx>ty则tx可以减去ty的倍数
3. 若ty>tx则ty可以减去tx的倍数
4. 用取模加速跳过多步
5. 最终检查是否到达(sx,sy)
